newsitem.title: USA: White House may delay FY98 budget to Feb 10.
newsitem.headline: White House may delay FY98 budget to Feb 10.

text.p: White House spokesman Mike McCurry suggested on Monday the Clinton administration might postpone releasing its fiscal year 1998 budget proposal by one week to Feb. 10.
"We are waiting for Congress to announce whether or not Feb. 5 is the date for the State of the Union," McCurry told reporters.

"We would prefer to submit the budget formally after the president delivers the State of the Union and ... perhaps we would try to do the traditional sequence of a Monday release, which would make Feb. 10 look like a date that you might focus on," he added.

Earlier, McCurry said the White House wanted to delay the budget until after Clinton delivers his annual State of the Union address, which is expected to be delivered on Feb. 5, and said Feb. 7 was one date under discussion.
By law, the president is required to send the budget to Congress by the first Monday in February, which this year falls on Feb. 3.
